title: Meeting panel on the grilling agent's tab, the Open channel header switch for every agent kind, and the preparing-speech-model state
story: The grilling agent's tab now carries the meeting screen: presence ticks, the consent tick with its read-aloud script, a Record switch with a red banner, speech-model download progress, Listen or Type, Use it, Skip, Jump, transcript import and a running transcript strip. A meeting agent is told the session file, who is present and the mode as soon as it is ready. Every agent tab also gets a "Channel" switch that feeds it the live transcript, and it can be turned on before a session starts. The meeting controls only appear on agents started for a meeting, and nothing starts those yet (issue #151).

checks.criterion: The Open channel switch shows inside every agent tab, beside the name and waiting dot, and shows the channel's real state.
checks.steps: Open a made-up project with no live session, press "+" and name a generic agent "Sample notes", turn on "Channel" in its tab, then turn it off.
checks.expected: A "Channel" switch in every agent tab; it stays on after the first click and goes off after the second.

checks.criterion: Before the first recording, the speech model download shows its progress and Record stays disabled.
checks.steps: Delete the model file from the app data folder; open a meeting agent's tab (needs the launcher from issue #151).
checks.expected: The card "Preparing speech model (downloading, N%)" with a progress bar, and Record disabled with "Record unlocks once the speech model is ready."

checks.criterion: A meeting agent is told the session file, who is present and the mode, with its channel closed.
checks.steps: Open a meeting agent's tab and wait for the agent to say it is ready.
checks.expected: The terminal receives 'session: .grillo/sessions/<date>-<time>.md', then 'present: <you>', then 'mode: type'.

checks.criterion: Record stays disabled until 'Everyone here agreed' is ticked; recording shows the red banner and the transcript strip.
checks.steps: On a meeting agent's tab, read the script aloud, tick 'Everyone here agreed', turn on Record, and say a made-up sentence.
checks.expected: 'Ticked by <you> at HH:MM.', then the red 'Recording' banner with a running timer, and the sentence in the strip under the terminal with a time.

checks.criterion: Listen, Type, Use it, Skip question and Jump to ticket each send their message to the agent.
checks.steps: While recording, press Listen, talk, press Use it, then Skip question, then pick a ticket under 'Jump to ticket…'.
checks.expected: The tab's Channel switch turns on with Listen; the talk then 'use it' arrive in the terminal, then 'skip', then 'jump <number>'.

checks.criterion: The presence ticks set who is present, and the agent is told each change.
checks.steps: On a meeting agent's tab, tick a second made-up member.
checks.expected: The agent receives 'present: <host>, <member>', and the hint lists both members' domains.
